seo.titulo: The most viewed video in Oceania this week 🏆 #shorts
seo.descripcion:
The podium of the most viewed videos in Oceania this week.

Full countdown, from 10 to 1: https://youtu.be/y6aWGV7sXsU

Data from the official YouTube API. Synthetic voice narration. #Top10RS #shorts

escenas.texto: Which was the most viewed video in Oceania this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, How to Wrap an Owl, by Owls in Towels, with over 3 million views.
In second place, Swimming between the flags, by CrackerMilk, with over 7 million views.
And number one: Testing Everything In GTA 6, by LazarBeam, with over 8 million views.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
